role: Rear-only cable guidance diagnostic; not the final eight-equation baseline
source: Ordinary Lasso D3plot node_displacement interpreted as current coordinates; coordinate convention independently checked against NODOUT in the case assessment
selection: Original front bore wall nodes within 0.005 mm of radius 4.9149 mm about X=+/-101.6 mm,Y=0, original Z=0..3.1751 mm
interpretation: Rear-only guidance allows front bore motion beyond the available cable clearance; omitted front cable contact affects the model. Use front and rear transverse guidance for the agreed ideal coaxial guide baseline, documenting the zero-clearance idealization.
limitations: Centroid displacement subtracts the same sampled nodes' initial centroid; irregular surface sampling has an approximately 0.28 mm initial X offset from the nominal axis.

The wall-to-cable clearance screen is based on saved nodes, not facet contact or unsaved times. Negative clearance already demonstrates geometric interference under the assumed fixed straight cable axis.
These values are diagnostic observations, not failure predictions or final baseline metrics.
